## Use Datatype in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Datatype for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Datatype', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

## Where to get Datatype

Datatype is available from Google Fonts.

[Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Datatype)

## About the Datatype coding font

A variable monospace designed for data-heavy interfaces and code. Datatype is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Datatype is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Datatype FAQ

### Is Datatype free?

Yes. Datatype is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Datatype support ligatures?

No. Datatype has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Datatype?

Datatype is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
